changesApplied.changeMade: Added SurrealDB metrics initialization before Redis cache. Now metrics are written to SurrealDB first (primary storage) via create_metrics(), then cached in Redis. Redis failure is non-fatal.
changesApplied.reason: Enforces cache-aside pattern: SurrealDB as primary storage, Redis as cache. Metrics persist beyond cache eviction. Aligns with template creation pattern (lines 342-348 already write template to SurrealDB first).
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Low impact - Additive change. Template creation now initializes metrics in both SurrealDB (primary) and Redis (cache). Backward compatible - existing Redis-only metrics will be backfilled on next execution.
validationCriteria: ✅ Metrics initialized in SurrealDB before Redis cache
✅ Redis failure is non-fatal (logged as warning)
✅ Template creation continues even if metrics initialization fails

pendingChanges.plannedChange: Invert write order from Redis-first to SurrealDB-first: (1) SurrealDB transaction (insert_execution + update_metrics_after_execution atomically), (2) Update Redis cache (read thompson_alpha/beta from SurrealDB result, write to Redis), (3) On Redis failure: log warning and continue (cache-aside tolerates misses)
pendingChanges.reason: Current implementation uses Redis-first pattern with compensating rollback (lines 509-586: Redis WATCH/MULTI/EXEC, lines 587-639: SurrealDB write, lines 641-683: rollback on failure). This is architecturally inconsistent - should treat SurrealDB as primary storage and Redis as cache layer.
pendingChanges.impactAnalysis: Medium risk - Changes write order and transaction semantics. Current atomicity guarantees via Redis WATCH/MULTI/EXEC need to be replaced with SurrealDB transaction. Careful testing required for concurrent execution scenarios.
pendingChanges.complexity: HIGH - Requires refactoring 230 lines of transaction logic

pendingChanges.plannedChange: Add cache-aside pattern: (1) On metrics cache miss (line 850-857): call surrealdb_get_metrics() and populate Redis cache, (2) Record selection to SurrealDB for analytics (call surrealdb_increment_selection), (3) Keep Redis selection count increment for fast queries (lines 884-906)
pendingChanges.reason: Current implementation only reads from Redis with no fallback (lines 850-857). If Redis loses metrics, selection fails. Selection count increments only in Redis (lines 884-906) - not persisted to SurrealDB for analytics.
pendingChanges.impactAnalysis: Low risk - Additive change that improves resilience. Adds SurrealDB fallback and selection tracking. Existing Redis-based selection continues to work.
pendingChanges.complexity: MEDIUM - Requires adding fallback logic and SurrealDB write
